Container.Name: hebrew-poc
Container.Overview: Hebrew learning app: short daily sessions with listening, reading and speaking cards, spaced repetition and a local Whisper speech check (CPU, no GPU needed). Sign-in with Google, each person has their own progress.[br][br] The free Edge voice works without any key. A Google TTS key gives the lessons a nicer voice; Azure and ElevenLabs are optional.[br][br] Progress (one SQLite file per person), 14 daily backups, the sign-in key and the audio cache live in App data. The speech model (~1.6 GB) downloads there on first use.[br][br] HTTPS (needed for sign-in and the microphone): put it behind SWAG with hebrew.subdomain.conf from github.com/jdrudolph/unraid-templates/tree/main/swag.
Container.Requires: The image is private: install the "hebrew-poc" plugin first (Plugins → Install Plugin, URL in github.com/jdrudolph/unraid-templates); it connects Docker to GitHub.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port on the server for opening the app in the LAN. SWAG doesn't need it (it talks to the container over proxynet). 8000 is often taken (e.g. by paperless-ngx).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Progress files, their daily backups, the sign-in key, audio cache and speech model. Back this folder up (Appdata Backup).

Config.Name: Google TTS API key
Config.Description: Optional. Google Cloud console → enable Cloud Text-to-Speech API → API key restricted to it. When set, the lessons use Google's voice.

Config.Name: Azure Speech key
Config.Description: Optional. portal.azure.com → Speech resource (free F0) → Keys and Endpoint.

Config.Name: Lesson voice
Config.Description: edge, google, azure or elevenlabs. Empty: google if its key is set, else edge.

Config.Name: Allowed emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated Google accounts that may sign in. Empty: the app's built-in list (Meltem, Jan). The first email keeps progress.db.

Config.Name: Speech model
Config.Description: ivrit-ai = Hebrew-tuned, most accurate (a few seconds per phrase on an N100). small = fast but weak at Hebrew.
